description: An audio editor for one sound: a demo loop, a file uploaded or dropped on it, or a take from the microphone after a count-in, drawn live as it records. The transport plays, loops and records, the sound menu picks or uploads, Undo and Redo follow, the meter and the main volume close the bar; the waveform seeks, zooms down to the samples and selects, its menu cuts, copies, pastes, deletes, crops and marks with their shortcuts; under it the track's device chain, an equalizer and a compressor to start, with the library beside it to add any effect. It plays on the audio clock through the arrangement engine
name: block-audio-editor
